newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier on weak demand.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in late trading on Monday as buyers returned to the sidelines and the impact of a sellers' pact to raise values began to wear off, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,400-05 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,405-10 rupiah at the opening. The traders said offers were also heard at 1,395 rupiah.
"Buyers have retreated after showing some interest on Saturday," one trader said. "Either they have covered their positions, or are confident prices will continue to weaken."
Several major players agreed at an informal meeting on Friday night on the need to raise palm olein prices, which had declined by some seven percent over the past four weeks.
They felt that there would be no processing margin because of the relatively high crude palm oil prices unless the price of palm olein was higher, traders said.
"It is one thing for sellers to raise prices, but another for the buyers to come out and support it," one trader said. "Buyers were active on Saturday, but have since quietened down."
